stem: A facility uses a clean-to-dirty work sequence. Which schedule best supports that control?
choices: Complete lower-risk propagation work before entering quarantine, then follow required change/sanitation steps before any return
Visit quarantine first because it is the most urgent room, then move directly to propagation
Alternate between quarantine and propagation to save walking time
Use the same gloves in every room if they look clean
rationale: Clean-to-dirty sequencing reduces avoidable movement from higher-risk areas into cleaner or more sensitive areas.
